open_points.text: - content_identity: [BEHAVIOR] For the idempotency_key variant MUST build one JSON object with one member per entry of fields, named by the entry's port and holding the JSON value its canonical_json encodes, so the order of the fields does not change the key, and return the hexadecimal SHA-256 of its canonical bytes; a field whose value is null is kept as null, not dropped.
open_points.other_text: - KeyFieldsContent fields (exact, no others exist): subject_kind: Literal['idempotency_key'], fields: tuple[JsonPayload, ...]
open_points.question: Which passage must change, or how are duplicate JsonPayload.port values reconciled? The model permits multiple tuple entries with the same port, but a JSON object cannot contain one distinct member per such entry under the required port-based member names.
